annotations.title: Ask to pause, resume or finish a phased release

description: Asks a person to approve a change to an App Store version's phased release (7 days, to a growing share of people with automatic updates): pause (they stop getting it; anyone can still download it from the App Store; Apple allows 30 days of pauses in all), resume (a paused one goes on from its day), or complete (everyone gets it now). Pass the release of the version's build (ploa_app_review_status gives it and says which of these apply). Nothing changes at Apple until a person approves on the Ploa dashboard; check it with ploa_approval_status. Needs a token allowed to touch production.

releaseId.description: The release ID that ploa_release_start returned.
